The shipped TaskDemo override implements tasks/update by calling self.tasks.update_task(&request.task_id, request.input_responses) and implements tasks/cancel by calling self.tasks.cancel_task(&request.task_id). In both overrides, RequestContext is ignored. Therefore any UpdateTaskParams or CancelTaskParams metadata not represented by task_id/input_responses is discarded at this example handler boundary and is not forwarded to TaskManager mutation. In this shipped example, request metadata cannot provide a historical CAS/fence for update/cancel because only task_id plus input_responses (update) or task_id alone (cancel) reaches TaskManager.
